protocol.question: Does an ImageNet-pretrained, degradation-aware and explanation-consistent video detector with calibrated, selective decisions give robust detection and stable, faithful explanations under real-world degradation?

data.source: prepared Test 5 run (split, face-crop caches, verified degraded versions, Grad-CAM pairs), read-only

stage2.init: best F0 checkpoint (EMA weights) of the same training set and seed
stage2.batch: each step: half originals + half degraded clips (F1) or original/degraded pairs (F2)

common.augmentation: 151026 real-world operators (crop, flip, colour, JPEG, blur, down-scaling, erasing); identical parameters for both clips of a pair

sampler.kind: adaptive group-DRO over dataset x folder cells (171026 harddro)

F0.description: ImageNet EfficientNet-B0 + temporal transformer + attention pooling, fine-tuned on clean originals with the group-DRO dataset x folder sampler (151026 / harddro12 recipe)

F1.description: F0 + degradation-aware Stage 2: unpaired 50/50 original/degraded clips, natural degradation mixture

F2.description: F0 + explanation-consistent Stage 2: paired original/degraded clips + Grad-CAM consistency + supervised contrastive consistency (final system)

protocol.model_selection: best epoch by validation score (EMA weights): F0 = mean over datasets of validation original AUC; F1/F2 = mean over datasets of mean(validation original AUC, validation degraded AUC)
protocol.calibration: temperature scaling (NLL grid) on validation originals + degraded versions of the training set's datasets; threshold = maximum of the balanced accuracy averaged over datasets

final_model.rule: Joint F2 unless its mean validation score over seeds is more than 0.005 below Joint F1 (then F1); within the variant the seed with the highest validation score (validation data only)
final_model.calibration: isotonic regression of the logit on validation
final_model.decision: threshold = max mean balanced accuracy on the isotonic probability
final_model.abstention: uncertain band tuned on validation for 90% coverage

evaluation.test: Test 5 test split of both datasets: originals + all verified degraded versions (in-domain, joint, cross-dataset)

gradcam.frames: every 2nd cached frame (offset 0; clean reference = offset 1)

faithfulness.pairs: every 4th Grad-CAM pair, original and degraded version

statistics.bootstrap: paired cluster bootstrap over source groups, seeds averaged
statistics.supported: 95 % CI excludes 0 and all seeds agree in sign

hypotheses: An ImageNet-pretrained backbone improves robustness over the Test 5 baseline (F1 vs 5A, in-domain)
Degraded training also helps the pretrained detector (F1 vs F0)
Explanation-consistency training improves Grad-CAM stability without losing detection (F2 vs F1)
The final joint detector beats the best earlier detector on the same test videos (F2 Joint vs 5A)
The dataset-specific final detectors generalise across datasets (cross-dataset AUC CI above 0.5)
Isotonic calibration and abstention make decisions reliable on original and degraded videos

baselines.T5-5A: Test 5 baseline 5A (from-scratch AV CNN, degraded training)

note: written before any training; every checkpoint records this protocol hash
